BIM-driven laser spatial augmented reality for in-situ layout and
            assembly
Overview
Why measure and mark what BIM already defines?
Convert BIM geometry into laser paths.
A low-cost laser projector for construction layout.
Prepare the layout digitally. Project it on site.
How accurate are the projected layouts?
A tripod-mounted prototype, with potential for robotic deployment.
From building layouts to assembly patterns.
